product_metadata.title: KitchenAid Nylon Slotted Turner, Red -
features: Durable turner: this KitchenAid slotted turner is strong and durable, made to last for a long time
Large turner: The large turner surface allows for easy food preparation or serving
Heat resistant: the nylon material is safe for all cookware, including non-stick. The Turner is heat resistant to 450°f/232°c
Ergonomic Handle: This turner has an ergonomic handle giving comfort while in use. The handle features a hole, allowing for convenient hanging storage
Dishwasher safe: this slotted turner is dishwasher safe, making clean up quick and easy. This turner comes with a 1-year Hassle-Free replacement and a lifetime Limited
description: The oversized head on this KitchenAid Nylon Slotted Turner allows you to turn steak or fish quickly and easily. It's also perfect for lifting quesadillas from the skillet. The nylon head is strong, durable and heat resistant to 450 degrees F. Safe to use on all cookware, including non-stick. Dishwasher safe. Slotted turner measures 14 inch long.
